dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 12, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Marlins Stun Pirates in Miami, 8-3**

Liam Hicks led the way for the Marlins with a 3-hit performance, including a home run, as Miami cruised to an 8-3 victory over the Pirates. Sandy Alcantara had a dominant outing on the mound, tossing 8 shutout innings and striking out 7. For the Pirates, Brandon Lowe hit his 17th home run of the season.

**Mets Outslug Braves, 7-5**

The Mets came from behind to defeat the Braves, 7-5. Bo Bichette had a massive game for the Mets, going 2-for-3 with two home runs and six RBIs. JR Ritchie pitched 5 strong innings for the Mets, allowing just 2 hits and striking out 5.

**Astros Come From Behind to Beat Royals, 10-8**

The Astros overcame a 5-run deficit to defeat the Royals, 10-8. Yordan Alvarez had a huge game for the Astros, going 3-for-5 with two home runs and six RBIs. AJ Blubaugh pitched 2 scoreless innings of relief for the Astros.

**Twins Edge Cardinals in Extra Innings, 9-8**

The Twins came from behind to defeat the Cardinals, 9-8 in extra innings. Brooks Lee hit his 11th home run of the season for the Twins, while Joe Ryan pitched 6 strong innings, striking out 8.

**Angels Shut Down Rays, 4-3**

The Angels held off a late rally by the Rays to win, 4-3. Mason Englert pitched 4 scoreless innings of relief for the Angels, striking out 3.
